purpose: Identify songs actually derived from real LunaRunes draws. Rune imagery alone is insufficient.
definition: rune_song = a song whose creative provenance explicitly includes a real rune draw result that was interpreted and then extended into lyrics/song.

classification.confirmed: Direct source record explicitly links a real draw to the song.
classification.high_candidate: Strong multi-source match such as same date plus exact drawn-rune title, but missing explicit creation provenance.
classification.medium_candidate: Temporal/contextual match to a known draw, but no direct rune linkage.
classification.author_recalled: Author recalls that rune songs were created using OW3gs 11-card draws, and identifies these candidates as likely belonging to that process. Stronger than metadata inference, but still distinct from a preserved original draw-to-song record.

rules: Do not classify a song as rune_song solely because its title or lyrics contain rune, moon, fate, shadow, light or similar motifs.
Do not classify by semantic similarity alone.
Confirmed records require an explicit draw-to-song provenance source.
Candidates remain separate from confirmed rune songs.
For the 福／禍 recovery clue, match either token independently; do not require both in the same song.
Rune-song recovery requires a minimum DISTINCT-rune threshold; two or three rune hits alone are insufficient.
Explicit rune-chant / 禁咒 works are excluded from rune-song recovery, ranking, and threshold calibration.
Rune-song search should not specially surface 禁咒 works; they are treated as an exception corpus, not candidate evidence.
Rune-song scoring is based on DISTINCT rune names only; repeated occurrences of the same rune add no score.
Each distinct rune contributes its signal-tier weight at most once per song.
Narrative songs can contain multiple rune-name tokens without being rune songs.
Same-date overlap with an OW3gs draw is insufficient when the author identifies the song as narrative-only.
All P1 songs are excluded from rune-song recovery because the author confirms the early-period songs were not rune-derived.
P1 must not be used to calibrate rune-song thresholds or rank candidates.
Songs created on or after 2026-06-11 are excluded from rune-song recovery because the physical deck was unavailable for that workflow.
The 2026-06-10 boundary date is handled by explicit song-level confirmation, not blanket exclusion.
Explicit author rejection overrides keyword density, distinct-rune count, date overlap, and semantic similarity.
Rune-song recovery is limited to P2, P3, and P4.
P1 and P5–P8 are hard exclusions for rune-song candidate generation.

recovery_clues.meaning: A rune-song candidate may contain either 「福」 or 「禍」 in the lyrics; simultaneous occurrence is not required.

rune_keyword_dictionary.purpose: Use all 66 rune names as first-pass lexical clues when recovering rune songs from private/full-lyrics sources.

scoring_rule.application: Apply weight once per DISTINCT rune only.
scoring_rule.note: Keyword score is only a recovery heuristic. It never proves rune_song status by itself.

ambiguity_notes.月: Very common motif in the author's music and project identity; must be treated as low-signal unless combined with other rune terms, OW3gs context, date evidence, or author confirmation.
ambiguity_notes.風: Very common motif across multiple ERAs; low-signal.
ambiguity_notes.命: Common in fate-related language; low-signal despite being a rune name.

suggested_recovery_logic: Scan full lyrics for all 66 rune names.
Count DISTINCT rune-name hits; repeated mentions of the same rune do not increase distinct-rune count.
Reject songs with only two or three rune-name hits as insufficient.
Only songs exceeding the configured distinct-rune threshold enter the rune-song candidate pool.
After threshold filtering, apply weighted signal tiers to prioritize candidates.
Treat 月／心／愛／夢／風／日 and similar common words as low-signal even when they contribute to the distinct count.
Boost candidates that align with a known OW3gs date, 11-card context, or author recollection.
Only author confirmation or preserved draw-to-song provenance can promote a candidate to confirmed.

threshold_policy.rule: A song must exceed a minimum count of distinct rune-name hits before it can enter the rune-song candidate pool.
threshold_policy.calibration_method: Use confirmed rune songs as positive examples and ordinary LOC3 songs as controls when the private/full-lyrics Excel is available.
threshold_policy.note: Two or three rune-name hits are explicitly insufficient by themselves.

counting_policy.rule: Each rune contributes at most once per song, regardless of how many times the same rune token appears.
counting_policy.example: 月月月月月 = 1 distinct rune hit, not 5 hits

exceptions.label: 禁咒／符文詠唱類
exceptions.rationale: These works deliberately enumerate or chant rune vocabulary as playful/explicit rune text; they are not OW3gs-derived rune songs and would distort keyword thresholds.
